description: Standalone Windows utility for editing file associations, context-menu entries, icons, descriptions, AutoPlay handlers, and default-program settings.
notes: The publisher describes this as a standalone application with no installation. Version 2.7.2676 dates from March 25, 2018; Windows 11 compatibility is not established.
This utility edits Windows file-association, context-menu, and AutoPlay settings. Review changes and keep a backup of relevant settings. It does not bypass Windows protected default-app controls.
